system.description: Characters whose minds operate beyond ordinary limits. Abilities may manifest as telekinetic force, mental influence, expanded perception, projected thought, or other expressions of focused consciousness.
system.benefit: Gain access to the Psionics Combat Skill. If acquired later: gain access to Psionics, gain 2 pips in it, then gain one additional Psionics Expertise and two additional Psionics Action Cards.

origin.name: Sacrificial Power
origin.text: You may spend Temporary Wounds as though they were dice when using Psionics Actions or Reactions.
